record_type_quote: The claim selected for replication from Zhu & Meyers-Levy (2009: Experiment 1) is that, because interdependents should rely on holistic processing, an assimilation effect should emerge, such that they will evaluate a neutral product as more modern and less natural when it is displayed on a glass table than when it is displayed on a wood table.

targets.evidence_quote: The claim selected for replication from Zhu & Meyers-Levy (2009: Experiment 1) is that, because interdependents should rely on holistic processing, an assimilation effect should emerge, such that they will evaluate a neutral product as more modern and less natural when it is displayed on a glass table than when it is displayed on a wood table.
targets.outcome_quote: H* was not supported as there was no main effect in the one way ANOVA. In addition, the means were directionally in the opposite direction of the effect shown in the paper.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The final report explicitly states that the focal hypothesis was unsupported and the means reversed direction. Both sequential collection stages are nonsignificant. COVID-related design changes do not negate this verdict.
